claims.content: The Operator acknowledges a device alarm and optionally silences the audible portion of the alarm.

goal.raw_text: The Operator acknowledges a device alarm and optionally silences the audible portion of the alarm.

claims.content: Operator
A device alarm condition must exist (e.g., critical or warning alarm generated due to specific device status changes or failures).

The Operator must be logged on to the system to interact with alarms (implied by the requirement for an operator to log on to respond to alarms in unattended mode, and the existence of personnel status tracking).

A critical or warning alarm condition is generated by the system due to specific device status changes, failures, or threshold violations (e.g., communication failure, power failure, security sensor activation).

trigger.raw_text: A critical or warning alarm condition is generated by the system due to specific device status changes, failures, or threshold violations (e.g., communication failure, power failure, security sensor activation).

claims.content: The system displays the Alarm Acknowledgment/Silencing Screen to the Operator.
The Operator acknowledges the alarm via the GUI.
The Operator has the option to silence the audible portion of the alarm for a configurable duration or permanently for that specific device.
The Operator may choose to silence the audible portion of the alarm for a configurable duration.
The Operator may choose to silence the audible portion of the alarm permanently for that specific device.
The alarm has been acknowledged by the Operator.
The audible portion of the alarm is silenced either for a configurable duration or permanently for that specific device, if the Operator chose to silence it.
The visual alarm indicator (icon) changes to the normal status icon automatically when the alarm condition is removed.
